oneLine: Jay Mehta is reportedly selling half of his stake in Kolkata Knight Riders for $400 million.

sources.title: Who is Jay Mehta? Meet Juhi Chawla’s husband selling half of his 45% KKR stake for $400 million

synopsis: Jay Mehta is reportedly agreeing to sell half of his 45 percent stake in the Indian Premier League franchise Kolkata Knight Riders to US-based investment management firm Ares Management for approximately $400 million. The proposed all-cash transaction involves offloading a 22.5 percent stake out of his existing holding and values the team at approximately $1.78 billion. The deal is nearing completion but remains subject to formal approval from the Board of Control for Cricket in India.
